data.title: 02 · 红角与白誓约
data.description: 【废墟温室礼堂·黄昏】02穿着带红色缎带的白色婚纱站在破碎玻璃穹顶下，细小的红角从头纱边缘露出；她把捧花举过肩，绿色眼睛带着顽皮挑衅，下一秒又因为被夸漂亮而露出柔软的笑。
data.action: 把捧花举到肩后，站在破碎穹顶下回望，顽皮笑意中流露柔软。
data.camera: cowboy shot, vertical framing, bouquet and broken glass dome visible
data.mood: 顽皮与真心同时露出的花嫁
data.promptProse: Zero Two holds the bouquet over one shoulder beneath the shattered greenhouse dome, looking back with a playful, softened smile. Orange sunset passes through the broken glass and outlines her veil beside the red horns.
data.animaCaption: She holds the bouquet over one shoulder beneath the shattered greenhouse dome.
